risk_if_not_implemented: Without Controlled Release of Sensitive / Regulated Data, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_1.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Controlled Release (DCH-08.3) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Restrict Sensitive / Regulated Data Access To Authorized Individuals
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to control and restrict access to sensitive and/or regulated data on digital and non-digital media formats to authorized individuals.
compensating_control_2.justification: Restrict Sensitive / Regulated Data Access To Authorized Individuals (DCH-07.1) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Controlled Release (DCH-08.3) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
